vcs.name: proof_of_LinklistResumeAll_entail_wit_4_2
vcs.annotation_location: LinklistResumeAll: successful KTaskWakeup return / loop-invariant backedge

blocker.message: The successful Wakeup backedge owns only os_inv(after), not old os_inv/current exclusivity. Its pure generic ktask_wakeup_step admits an old SUSPEND task simultaneously in the target Event and a Semaphore pending queue, removes it from both, and reaches a valid after state. With waiting=remaining=[task] and locked=current, old progress is reflexive, but new empty-remainder progress demands an Event-only batch effect that preserves the changed Semaphore, so the consequent fails. Extract and retain old sched-owner NoDup/world facts from the pre-call invariant across the call.
